Tooltip.SceneDetect: Use PySceneDetect to automatically find scene changes in the video for splitting or batch processing.
Tooltip.SceneDetectThreshold: Adjust sensitivity for scene change detection. Lower values = more cuts; higher values = fewer cuts.
Tooltip.DetectScenesExtract: Run scene detection and automatically extract the detected scenes for further processing.
Tooltip.ModeSelect: Choose between single render mode (generate one 3D video) or batch mode (process multiple video + depth map pairs).
Tooltip.ApplyEntries: Apply the current Depth & Parallax Controls values to update the preview and rendering parameters.
Tooltip.Model: Select a depth estimation model from Hugging Face. Larger models offer higher accuracy but require more VRAM and time.
Tooltip.OutputDirLabel: Displays the currently selected output folder where all generated depth maps and videos will be saved.
Tooltip.OutputDirButton: Open a dialog to select the folder where all processed results will be stored.
Tooltip.ColormapLabel: Choose a visual colormap to colorize the depth map (e.g., Viridis, Magma, Inferno).
Tooltip.ColormapDropdown: Applies the chosen colormap to visualize depth perception in preview and saved outputs.
Tooltip.InvertCheckbox: Flips near/far values in the depth map. Useful if the depth appears inverted.
Tooltip.SaveFramesCheckbox: Enable to save individual per-frame depth images in addition to the output video.
Tooltip.BatchSizeEntry: Set how many frames are processed per batch. Lower values reduce VRAM usage at the cost of speed.
Tooltip.ProcessImage: Processes a single image file to generate a depth map.
Tooltip.ProcessImageFolder: Processes all images in a selected folder using current depth settings.
Tooltip.ProcessVideo: Processes a video file to generate a full-depth map video.
Tooltip.ProcessVideoFolder: Processes all video files in a folder for batch depth generation.
Tooltip.InferenceSteps: Controls the number of steps the diffusion model uses to estimate depth. Higher values may improve quality but increase processing time.
Tooltip.InferenceRes: Controls the size of resolution into the selected depth model, Keep original to feed full resolution into depth model
Tooltip.CPUMode: Determines which parts of the model to offload to the CPU. Use 'sequential' for low VRAM systems to reduce GPU memory usage at the cost of speed.
Tooltip.StartButton: Begin generating a 3D side-by-side (SBS) or other formats using all current parameters.
Tooltip.PreviewButton: Preview the 3D output frame-by-frame to verify depth before and test settings before rendering.
Tooltip.SuspendButton: Temporarily pause the current 3D rendering process.
Tooltip.ResumeButton: Resume 3D rendering if it was previously paused.
Tooltip.CancelButton: Abort the 3D rendering process and discard in-progress output.
Tooltip.ResetButton: Reset all values and sliders back to default configuration.
Tooltip.OptionMenu: Choose your 3D output format. Includes SBS, Anaglyph, Interlaced, VR, and others.
Tooltip.AspectPreview: Displays a live preview of output resolution and aspect ratio based on current settings.
Tooltip.Sharpness: Controls image sharpening after 3D warping. Negative values sharpen the image.
Tooltip.DOFStrength: Controls the intensity of Depth of Field blur. Higher values simulate stronger focus falloff from the center depth plane.
Tooltip.PreserveAspect: Keep the source video's original aspect ratio in the final 3D output.
Tooltip.AutoCrop: Automatically removes black bars before 3D transformation to avoid artifacts.
Tooltip.SkipBlankFrames: Skips blank/white frames from being rendered. Useful for cleaner cuts.
Tooltip.UseFFmpeg: Enable FFmpeg rendering for faster encoding. Requires FFmpeg in system PATH.
Tooltip.CRF: CRF controls CPU video quality: lower = better quality. 18-23 is visually lossless.
Tooltip.NVENCCQ: NVIDIA NVENC quality control. Similar to CRF but optimized for GPU encoding.
Tooltip.SelectedCodec: Standard codec used for CPU-based video export.
Tooltip.FFmpegCodec: Advanced encoder for FFmpeg export. NVENC is best for NVIDIA GPUs.
Tooltip.AspectRatio: Choose the final aspect ratio to match your target display or platform.
Tooltip.ExtractFrames: Extracts raw image frames from a video file for use with RIFE or ESRGAN processing.
Tooltip.RIFE: Enables AI interpolation to multiply frame rate for smooth slow motion or real-time upscaling.
Tooltip.ESRGAN: Uses Real-ESRGAN AI to upscale low-resolution frames with enhanced detail.
Tooltip.Resolution: Specifies the output resolution for the final rendered video (e.g., 1920x1080).
Tooltip.OriginalFPS: Input the source video's native frame rate for accurate interpolation.
Tooltip.FPSMultiplier: Controls how many extra frames are generated between originals (e.g., 2x, 4x, 8x FPS).
Tooltip.AIBlend: Controls how much AI output is blended with the original. High values preserve more source texture.
Tooltip.InputResPct: Downscales input before upscaling to save memory or improve speed. 100% = full resolution.
Tooltip.ModelSelect: Choose an ESRGAN ONNX model. x2 = faster, x4 = sharper but slower.
Tooltip.Saturation: Adjust color intensity. >1 boosts vividness; <1 desaturates; 0 is grayscale.
Tooltip.Contrast: Expand or compress tonal range around mid-gray (0.5). Higher = punchier.
Tooltip.Brightness: Add/subtract overall lightness after contrast. Use small steps (±0.05).
Tooltip.IPDShift: Adjusts the interpupillary distance multiplier to exaggerate or reduce stereo separation.
Tooltip.EnableIPD: Enable or disable IPD-based stereo scaling. When off, value is ignored (0.0).
Tooltip.AddVideo: Add a video file to the batch processing list.
Tooltip.AddDepthMap: Add a corresponding depth map file to the batch processing list.
Tooltip.StartBatchRender: Begin rendering all video + depth map pairs in the batch list using the current 3D settings.
Tooltip.ColorResetButton: Reset all color grading adjustments (saturation, contrast, brightness, etc.) back to defaults.
Tooltip.Output: Choose overwrite v2 frames folder or choose own path
Tooltip.LROutput: Choose which eye(s) to render: Left, Right, or a stereo pair (SBS).
Tooltip.DeleteOutputbtn: Deletes SBS video after Left or Right eye is generated
Tooltip.ClipRangeLabel: Optionally trim your render by setting a start and end time.
Tooltip.StartClipRangeLabel: Leave empty to start at the beginning. Accepts HH:MM:SS[.ms] or seconds.
Tooltip.EndClipRangeLabel: Leave empty to render until the end. Accepts HH:MM:SS[.ms] or seconds.
Tooltip.KeepAudio: If enabled, copies the original video's audio into the final 3D render without re-encoding.
Tooltip.Float16Button: Use 16-bit (float16) precision for faster depth inference when supported. May slightly change depth accuracy.
Tooltip.Audiobtn: Open the Audio Tool to remove or attach audio tracks to your video.
Tooltip.Livebtn: Start Live 3D with external inputs (webcam, capture card, or screen).
Tooltip.DB.V1Path: Select the V1 (whites) source — folder for frames or a video file.
Tooltip.DB.V2Path: Select the V2 (base) source — folder for frames or a video file.
Tooltip.DB.Width: Optional final output width. Leave blank to keep source.
Tooltip.DB.Height: Optional final output height. Leave blank to keep source.
Tooltip.DB.KeepSource: If width/height are blank, the original size is preserved.
Tooltip.DB.WhiteStrength: Amount of white-detail blend from V1 into V2.
Tooltip.DB.FeatherKernel: Feather blur size for blend mask (odd values work best).
Tooltip.DB.CLAHEClip: Local contrast limit (CLAHE). Higher = more contrast.
Tooltip.DB.CLAHETiles: CLAHE tile grid size (local region size).
Tooltip.DB.BilateralD: Bilateral filter diameter. Larger smooths more.
Tooltip.DB.PreviewFrame: Select the frame to preview using the slider or the buttons.
Tooltip.DB.BlendParms: Adjust blend parameters to control the strength and sharpness of the merge.
Tooltip.DB.ModeTitle: Choose between processing folders (frames) or videos.
Tooltip.FGShift_v4: Controls foreground displacement. The new Gaussian band weighting applies this per-pixel based on depth value, creating a more natural pop effect than the old global shift.
Tooltip.MGShift_v4: Adjust the parallax for midground layers. The Gaussian mid-band creates natural depth transitions between near and far.
Tooltip.BGShift_v4: Controls background displacement. Combined with BG Push Multiplier and the far Gaussian band, this creates realistic depth recession instead of a flat background.
Tooltip.ParallaxBalance_v4: Global stereo strength multiplier applied after all depth shaping and band weighting. Start at 0.70-0.78 and adjust to taste. Higher values create stronger 3D but may cause eye strain.
Tooltip.MaxPixelShift_v4: Hard clamp on maximum stereo displacement in pixels. Prevents extreme shifts from creating uncomfortable viewing. The new pipeline's band weighting respects this limit across all depth layers.
Tooltip.ConvergenceStrength_v4: Adds a stereo convergence offset to control the perceived screen-depth of the main subject.
Tooltip.ZeroParallaxStrength_v4: Fine-tune the screen-depth offset after subject tracking and convergence are applied. Small adjustments (±0.005-0.015) to push or pull the entire scene.
Tooltip.DepthPopGamma_v4: Power curve applied to the shaped depth before Gaussian band weighting. Below 1.0 emphasizes mid-depth contrast; above 1.0 flattens the depth profile.
Tooltip.PopMid_v4: Target depth midpoint for the subject after shaping and stretching. Adjusts where the 'center' of the depth range sits relative to the subject.
Tooltip.StretchLo_v4: Lower percentile for depth range stretching. Lower values give the near Gaussian band more dynamic range to work with. Typical: 0.03-0.08.
Tooltip.StretchHi_v4: Upper percentile for depth range stretching. Higher values give the far Gaussian band more room for background separation. Typical: 0.92-0.98.
Tooltip.FGPop_v4: Multiplier to emphasize foreground pop-out. Keep near 1.0 — the Gaussian band weighting already handles near emphasis. Higher values can cause cardboard cutout effect.
Tooltip.BGPush_v4: Multiplier to push background deeper. Increase to give distant objects more stereo separation. Overuse can create edge artifacts on wide shots.
Tooltip.SubjectLock_v4: How strongly to lock zero-parallax to the detected subject. Higher values keep the subject at screen depth, reducing edge artifacts on wide shots.
Tooltip.SubjectTracking_v4: Keeps key subjects centered at screen-depth for comfortable viewing. The new pipeline derives this from the same Gaussian weighting used for stereo.
Tooltip.DynamicConvergence_v4: Automatically adjusts convergence based on the tracked subject depth path (not shaped depth). Keeps subject placement stable across cuts and camera movements.
Tooltip.FloatingWindow_v4: Dynamically applies floating window bars when edge violations are detected in the shift field. Bar width and side respond to measured edge risk rather than inferred parallax alone.
Tooltip.EdgeMasking_v4: Suppresses pixel shift values near sharp depth edges before the warp. This reduces the size of disocclusion holes at the source, making the repair system's job easier.
Tooltip.Feathering_v4: Enables the occlusion repair and feathering pipeline. When disabled, raw warp output is shown with visible disocclusion holes. Keep enabled for final renders.
Tooltip.DisableShiftEMA: DEBUG: Disables temporal smoothing on the shift field. When unchecked, shifts are temporally smoothed to reduce jitter. Enable to see raw per-frame shift values for pipeline validation.
Tooltip.GaussianBands: The stereo pipeline uses overlapping Gaussian near/mid/far bands to create natural depth layering instead of discrete foreground/background shifts. This produces smoother depth transitions across the scene.
Tooltip.EdgeRepair: The contour-safe repair system detects disocclusion zones from shift geometry and fills them with directional background pixels. Protection barriers prevent repair from crossing into foreground silhouettes.
Tooltip.PreviewMode: Select how the stereo preview is displayed. Red-Blue Anaglyph works with standard 3D glasses. HSBS shows raw side-by-side. Heatmap modes visualize the shift field for debugging.
Tooltip.ConvergenceGuides: Overlays crosshair guides on the preview to help verify stereo alignment and convergence.
Tooltip.FrameSlider: Scrub through source frames to preview stereo output. Preview updates on slider release after a short debounce for smooth scrubbing.
Tooltip.OutputFormat: Full-SBS: each eye at full resolution (3840x1080 for 1080p). Half-SBS: half horizontal per eye. Anaglyph: red-cyan for glasses. Interlaced: alternating rows for passive 3D displays.
Tooltip.StereoMode: SBS outputs both eyes as a stereo pair. Left/Right renders a single eye. Both renders left and right as separate files.
Tooltip.Presets: Load and save complete stereo configurations as JSON preset files including all shift values, depth shaping, toggles, and color grading.
Tooltip.LoadPreviewSources: Open the input video and depth map for live preview. The frame slider becomes active once sources are loaded.
Tooltip.DepthEngineModel: Select from 25+ depth estimation models. The model warms up on selection — wait for 'Model ready' before processing.
Tooltip.BlendPresets: Quick-apply preset combinations of all 7 blend parameters. Default (Balanced) works for most cases. Metric + Mono is optimized for blending metric and relative depth maps.
